# BASIC_MATERIALS weekly digest — 2026-W44

**Coverage published or changed.** TPIA.JK is the desk's only published name this week: initiation 29 October, then two 30 October refreshes to v3 — ADD, target Rp1,489 versus a Rp1,350 price [TPIA report](coverage/companies/TPIA.JK/report.md). The update re-underwrites the nine-month spread: revenue US$8.19bn, attributable profit US$279.81m (-78.4% y/y, a base effect from last year's US$1.81bn Aster bargain gain), and a Q3 that was loss-making at the operating line before other gains. No other BASIC_MATERIALS name has published coverage.

**Deck moves.** The metals deck was re-reviewed on 27 October: all seven metals now carry World Bank Pink Sheet October-2026 actuals and spot prints, with FY2027E–long-run on the World Bank CMO April-2026 anchors — gold US$4,300/oz, silver US$65, copper US$11,000/t, aluminium US$3,000/t, nickel US$17,500/t, tin US$37,000/t, iron ore US$95/t [metals deck S2, S4]. Copper (+32% spot versus anchor) and tin (+45%) are treated as squeezes, not persistent levels; nickel's anchor sits above the US$16,324 September print, consistent with the macro desk's nickel FAVOR tilt. TPIA's oil input, re-reviewed by the Energy desk on 26 October, holds FY2027E Brent at US$84 and long-run US$75 against a US$112.79 spot — the war-premium tape is treated as temporary.

**Material news.** TPIA replaced its earlier buyback with up to Rp2tn for 1.6bn shares (1.84%) at a maximum Rp3,000 through 28 January 2027. INCO's nine-month profit was US$147m versus US$52m, revenue US$896m (+27%), Q3 matte 18,341t [INCO](https://www.idxchannel.com/market-news/laba-vale-inco-tembus-usd147-juta-hingga-september-naik-tiga-kali-lipat). ANTM's nine-month profit rose 46% to Rp9.66tn on gold and nickel [ANTM](https://www.cnbcindonesia.com/market/20261028074103-17-780042/laba-antam-naik-46-di-kuartal-iii-ini-penyebabnya). KRAS earmarked US$350m/Rp6.3tn for a stainless-slab project [KRAS](https://www.idxchannel.com/market-news/krakatau-steel-kras-siapkan-dana-rp63-triliun-untuk-proyek-stainless-steel); SMGR is reviewing a buyback with no size or timing [SMGR](https://investasi.kontan.co.id/news/semen-indonesia-smgr-berencana-buyback-saham-ini-tujuannya). None of these four is covered.

**What to watch next week.** TPIA's queued update on the US$8.2bn sales release; Q4 spread versus the nine-month trough and buyback execution. The November Pink Sheet edition will refresh metals actuals — test the copper and tin spot-to-anchor gaps and nickel's US$17,500 anchor. On nickel, RKAB quota discipline and the HPM formula; on cement and steel, SMGR buyback terms, KRAS project funding and ISSP margins against a 5.75% policy rate and USD/IDR 18,350 [macro deck FY2027E].
